name: drift
tagline: A git diff pager that is actually pleasant to look at
description: drift is a git diff tool and pager designed to make diffs enjoyable to read. It hit the HN front page on 6 August under the pitch "Drift, your new favorite Git Diff tool." In a category where most tools are judged on raw speed, drift is competing on readability — a meaningful bet, since developers read far more diffs than they write.
highlights: A diff pager optimized for readability
117 stars in a category dominated by established tools
Competes on how diffs feel, not just how fast they run
curatorNote: Every dev reads diffs all day; almost nobody loves their diff tool. Drift betting on aesthetics in a category that competes on speed is exactly the kind of contrarian bet worth watching.
